get_gui_scenarios: get all GUI scenarios from the registry and HuggingFace demo universes with lazy loading
lazy_getitem_access: access a specific GUI scenario by its scenario ID key using bracket notation
lazy_contains_check: check if a scenario ID exists in the GUI scenarios dictionary using the in operator
lazy_iterate_scenarios: iterate over all available GUI scenario IDs using a for loop on GUI_SCENARIOS
lazy_update_scenarios: update the GUI scenarios dictionary with new scenarios and clear the cached results
